text:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — we're shipping a small-but-breaking change to SDK config parsing and the docs this afternoon. Affects: `timeout_ms` -> normalized to `timeout` (ms->seconds) and the `embeddings.pooling` option is being removed in favor of model-backed defaults. Please read migration notes below and ping if you rely on these fields. :megaphone:

Samira Patel: Is this a patch release or minor? Customers with pinned versions — are they safe?

Alex Chen: It's a minor (4.2.0) — runtime will refuse the old keys unless `compat_mode: true` is set. Pinning older SDKs remains safe; this only affects clients that auto-upgrade. We'll keep compat flag for 30 days.

Tess Nguyen: Docs PR: https://git.internal.redwood/docs/pull/482 — includes examples and a migration snippet. I pushed a short changelog entry and sample patch.

deploy-bot: docs-pipeline: published https://docs.redwood-inference.com/sdk/migration/compat-capsule (live in ~5m)

Marcos Rivera: For internal demos (sandbox), what's the easiest opt-in to avoid interruptions?

Alex Chen: For demos add a single top-level flag in your config:
```
redwood:
  compat_mode: true  # accepts legacy keys for 30 days
  compat_mode_expires: "2026-04-25"
```
This will log a warning but continue to accept `timeout_ms` and `embeddings.pooling`.

Samira Patel: Will analytics / telemetry surface who used compat_mode so we can follow up with teams?

Tess Nguyen: Yes — we've added `compat_mode:true` to the docs telemetry table and a dashboard tile. I'll share the dashboard link in #eng-monitoring when it's ready.

Alex Chen: TL;DR migration steps for engs:
1) Run `rg "timeout_ms|embeddings.pooling"` across repos.
2) Replace `timeout_ms` with `timeout` (seconds) or use `compat_mode` temporarily.
3) Remove `embeddings.pooling` and rely on model defaults, or pin an embedding model with explicit behavior.
4) Update quickstarts from the docs PR.

Alex Chen: If you hit a blocker, @tess or I can help — add repros in #help or open a ticket with `docs-migrate` tag. :pray:
